rules.statement: Section 7 of the Limitation Ordinance No. 22 of 1871 applies to actions on written contracts, and not section 9 which pertains to goods sold and delivered.
rules.supporting_quote: "The only difficulty is in the application. The rule is that whenever there is a particular enactment and a general enactment in the same statute, and the latter, taken in its most comprehensive sense, would over-rule the former, the particular enactment must be operative, and the general enactment must be taken to affect only the other parts of the statute to which it may properly apply."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 7 of Ordinance No. 22 of 1871 or null
